question_papers.paper_title: Set 1 - Chemical Reactions and Equations Practice Paper

questions.question_text: Which of the following represents a combination reaction?
options: CaO(s) + H2O(l) -> Ca(OH)2(aq)
2Pb(NO3)2(s) -> 2PbO(s) + 4NO2(g) + O2(g)
Fe(s) + CuSO4(aq) -> FeSO4(aq) + Cu(s)
Na2SO4(aq) + BaCl2(aq) -> BaSO4(s) + 2NaCl(aq)
questions.correct_answer: CaO(s) + H2O(l) -> Ca(OH)2(aq)

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements correctly describes key observations in Chemical Reactions and Equations (Set 1)?
options: Core process in Chemical Reactions and Equations obeys conservation laws and standard reaction conditions.
Process in Chemical Reactions and Equations violates mass conservation.
No physical or chemical state change occurs during the reaction.
Products have higher total mass than initial reactants.
questions.correct_answer: Core process in Chemical Reactions and Equations obeys conservation laws and standard reaction conditions.

questions.question_text: What physical state symbol or indicator color change is associated with Chemical Reactions and Equations (Set 1)?
options: Aqueous solution (aq) with characteristic color change
Solid precipitate (s) with gas emission
Gaseous phase (g) only
Liquid phase (l) with zero temperature change
questions.correct_answer: Aqueous solution (aq) with characteristic color change

questions.question_text: Identify the correct SI unit or mathematical relationship relevant to Chemical Reactions and Equations (Set 1).
options: Standard NCERT Formula & Unit
Dimensionless Ratio x 100
Inverse Square Exponential
Absolute Constant Zero
questions.correct_answer: Standard NCERT Formula & Unit

questions.question_text:
Assertion (A): Fundamental processes in Chemical Reactions and Equations strictly follow thermodynamic and chemical principles.
Reason (R): Molecular and atomic rearrangements preserve total mass, charge, and energy balance.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.correct_answer: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

question_papers.paper_title: Set 4 - Chemical Reactions and Equations Practice Paper

questions.question_text: Why does the blue color of copper sulphate solution fade when an iron nail is immersed in it?
options: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D
questions.correct_answer: Iron is more reactive than copper and displaces copper from CuSO4 solution to form pale green ferrous sulphate (FeSO4).

question_papers.paper_title: Set 5 - Chemical Reactions and Equations Practice Paper

questions.question_text: In the electrolysis of water experiment, why is the volume of gas collected at one electrode double the volume collected at the other?
options: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D
questions.correct_answer: Water (H2O) consists of hydrogen and oxygen in a 2:1 atomic ratio. Electrolysis produces 2 volumes of Hydrogen gas at the cathode for every 1 volume of Oxygen gas at the anode.
